title: Microsoft Purview Scan Coverage and Failures
dataSources: Collibra audit (`collibra:audit`), Alation/Atlan audit, DataHub events, OpenLineage runs (`openlineage:event`), Unity Catalog audit (`unity_catalog:audit`), Purview scans (`purview:scan`).
app: Catalog/governance audit exports (Collibra, Alation, Atlan, DataHub, Unity Catalog, Microsoft Purview) via REST APIs and OpenLineage events to HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=purview:scan
| stats count as runs, sum(eval(status="Failed")) as failures, latest(_time) as last_scan by data_source, scan_name
| eval days_since=round((now()-last_scan)/86400,1)
| where failures>0 OR days_since>7
| sort - days_since
description: Tracks Microsoft Purview scan runs to flag both outright failures and data sources that have not been scanned recently, since stale scans mean the catalog misses new or changed assets.
value: A catalog is only as current as its last scan; combining failure and staleness detection keeps Purview's classification and lineage trustworthy.
implementation: Poll Purview scan history via API into HEC; schedule daily and alert on failed or overdue scans for governed sources.
visualization: Table of data source by failures and days since scan.
grandmaExplanation: We make sure the tool that catalogues your data keeps scanning on schedule so nothing new slips through uncatalogued.
